stage0018_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$タケル$$
「Yeah... lately I see it almost every day」

stage0018_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ナオト$$
「If $$タケル$$'s having a dream like that...」

stage0018_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$アキラ$$
「Could it be some kind of premonition?」

stage0018_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$タケル$$
「I don't know.
　Maybe I'm just overreacting to that word
　'demon king' from the other day」

stage0018_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$タケル$$
「The one who brings ruin in my dream
　feels more like an angel than a demon king」

stage0018_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$甲児$$
「What... another one of $n's occult hobbies?」

stage0018_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$n
「Please, $$タケル$$...
　tell me about the dream you saw」

stage0018_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$さやか$$
（Um, $$甲児$$...
　the mood's too heavy to joke about）

stage0018_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$甲児$$
（Y-yeah...
　he's more serious than usual...）

stage0018_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$タケル$$
「Even if you ask me to explain,
　it's all vague, since it's a dream」

stage0018_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$n
「This angel you saw, what was it?」

stage0018_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$タケル$$
「It has no definite shape,
　just wrapped in white light, descending
　from the sky... a collage of images like that」

stage0018_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$タケル$$
「When it comes down to the ground,
　the world's wrapped in light and meets ruin」

stage0018_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's like something out of Revelation...」

stage0018_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm not doubting $$タケル$$'s precognition,
　but just from that, it sounds a lot like
　common apocalyptic thinking out there」

stage0018_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ミカ$$
「That kind of thing's out there in the world?」

stage0018_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Sorry.
　'Common' was probably too strong a word」

stage0018_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's from the 《$$オカルトフォーラム$$》 I visit often.
　There, that kind of talk comes into fashion
　every so often」

stage0018_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But most of it just stretches the words
　of myths or shady prophets to fit,
　and lacks any validity or logic」

stage0018_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You could say it's the vague wish of
　dissatisfied people to break free of their
　situation, taking a negative shape」

stage0018_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Actually, this happened last century too...」

stage0018_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$甲児$$
「M-Miss $$スズネ$$... hold on a sec!
　I can't keep up with this!」

stage0018_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Sorry.
　Seems I got a little carried away」

stage0018_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$さやか$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ and $n really do
　love occult stories, don't they」

stage0018_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アキラ$$
「It's surprising that cheerful, upbeat
　Miss $$スズネ$$ likes that kind of thing」

stage0018_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$n
「...Sorry about that.
　For not being cheerful or upbeat」

stage0018_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ナオト$$
「Oh... guess you're aware of it」

stage0018_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ナオト$$
「I wasn't trying to tease him.
　That's just part of who he is」

stage0018_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ロゼ$$
（That's not just personality...
　that man, $F, is...）

stage0018_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$タケル$$
「...That's about all I've got.
　Good enough, $n?」

stage0018_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$n
「Thanks.
　If you see anything like that again, tell me」

stage0018_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$葵$$
「Then how about a nap, $$タケル$$?」

stage0018_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$タケル$$
「Even on standby, I can't just do that」

stage0018_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$葵$$
「Figured you'd say that.
　You're always so serious, $$タケル$$」

stage0018_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$朔哉$$
「But aren't we way too bored...
　$$甲児$$ and $n's group even get school off,
　and all we do is stand by」

stage0018_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$くらら$$
「And yet the Far East Branch's so busy」

stage0018_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ナオト$$
「From what I heard,
　they've deployed forces around Sagami Bay」

stage0018_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Sagami Bay means $$第３新東京市$$ and the red sea...」

stage0018_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$タケル$$
「I see...
　$$ロゼ$$, you've barely set foot on Earth
　since the $$新世時空震動$$ happened...」

stage0018_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$タケル$$
「The area near Sagami Bay shifted here
　from a world that's neither $$ＵＣＷ$$ nor $$ＡＤＷ$$」

stage0018_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$タケル$$
「Areas from that world aren't just
　around Sagami Bay, either. They're scattered
　worldwide, like the Arctic and parts of Europe」

stage0018_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$甲児$$
「You could call it a third world after $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$」

stage0018_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$タケル$$
「In their world, a city like Tokyo
　apparently stretched from Sagami Bay to Hakone」

stage0018_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$タケル$$
「But the research city with $$甲児$$'s school
　was already set to be named $$第２新東京市$$,
　so that area's called $$第３新東京市$$ instead」

stage0018_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「So, what is that red sea?」

stage0018_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$スズネ$$
「In that third world, a disaster struck
　fifteen years ago and changed everything」

stage0018_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's called the 《$$セカンドインパクト$$》, and ever
　since, the seas worldwide turned red and
　most marine life died out」

stage0018_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「No details were ever released,
　so we don't know specifics, but it was
　clearly a global-scale disaster」

stage0018_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$甲児$$
「The red sea shifted over too, along
　with the third world, but oddly enough
　it just won't mix with our seawater」

stage0018_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$タケル$$
「Hyperspace physicists say it's because
　the third world itself hasn't blended into
　this one, which causes that state」

stage0018_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$タケル$$
「In other words, that world shares our
　dimension, but with a slight phase shift」

stage0018_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ナオト$$
「Hard to swallow, but since it's
　really happening, guess we accept it」

stage0018_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$アキラ$$
「What I don't get is why they need
　to deploy forces to $$第３新東京市$$」

stage0018_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ミカ$$
「True.
　Some fraction of the Far East Branch's
　forces are always stationed around there...」

stage0018_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$タケル$$
「Director $$大塚$$ and Mr. $$城田$$'s trip
　might be connected to that too...」

stage0018_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$大塚$$
「...So you don't intend to disclose
　NERV's founding, its forces, or its facilities?」

stage0018_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Do not misunderstand.
　It simply isn't the time yet」

stage0018_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$大塚$$
「If a time to speak will come eventually,
　when would that be?」

stage0018_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$大塚$$
「Not even now, when Federation High Command
　has ordered the Far East Branch to full alert?」

stage0018_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$大塚$$
「As the one entrusted with the Far East
　Branch, I need to know at least the basics」

stage0018_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$大塚$$
「Commander Ikari, at least tell me about
　these 'Angels,' and the worst case scenario,
　what's called the 'Third Impact'」

stage0018_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$大塚$$
「Just as the name suggests, is the Third
　Impact a phenomenon like the $$セカンドインパクト$$
　that happened in your world?」

stage0018_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$大塚$$
「What is the mechanism behind it?
　And what relationship does NERV
　have with these Angels?」

stage0018_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$城田$$
（Why...
　In just a few months since we shifted here,
　how did NERV come to wield this much power...）

stage0018_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$城田$$
（Special ties to the top of gov't and military...?）

stage0018_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「...Understood.
　I'll be right there」

stage0018_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Just as you suspected.
　The Fourth Angel has appeared in Sagami Bay」

stage0018_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...This is bad...
　The meeting time's already passed...」

stage0018_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「It'll be dark soon, and I'm all alone...」

stage0018_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Who was that kid just now...」

stage0018_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Still, this city...
　there's almost no one around...」

stage0018_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You're $$碇シンジ$$, right?
　Anyway, let's get moving from here」

stage0018_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Whew... Guess we can breathe for now.」

stage0018_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That was close, huh.
　...Although the reason was
　me being late to our meeting spot.」

stage0018_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Just $$ミサト$$ is fine.
　Nice to meet you properly, $$碇シンジ$$.」

stage0018_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...You're not going to ask anything?」

stage0018_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ミサト$$
「It's not that you need to apologize...
　But wouldn't you at least ask what that
　huge thing was, or what's going on?」

stage0018_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$シンジ$$
「No, um... I figured that even if I asked,
　you wouldn't tell me anything anyway...」

stage0018_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You're oddly quick to assume things.
　That's not very kid-like of you.」

stage0018_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...It's fine.
　I'm just doing as $$先生$$, the person who
　looked after me, told me to.」

stage0018_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I see... Well, fine.
　That thing was an Angel, a mysterious life form.」

stage0018_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ミサト$$
「And this is the special agency, NERV.」

stage0018_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Right, a covert group under the Earth Federation.」

stage0018_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Well, yeah.
　Do you know what your dad does for work?」

stage0018_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$先生$$ told me it's important work,
　protecting humanity. ...Are we going to see him now?」

stage0018_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's right.
　I think someone should be coming to get you soon.」

stage0018_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...I see. Not good with him... your dad.」

stage0018_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$リツコ$$'s the one picking us up?」

stage0018_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Circumstances have changed.
　He's heading straight to the hangar now.」

stage0018_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
Ritsuko
「Technology Division, Section 1, head of
　the E Project, $$赤木リツコ$$. Nice to meet you.」

stage0018_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$リツコ$$
「That's mankind's ultimate all-purpose humanoid weapon
　the artificial being, Evangelion... Unit-01.
　Humanity's last trump card.」

stage0018_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That thing... it's not a Mobile Suit,
　or a Super Robot, is it...」

stage0018_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$リツコ$$
「In our world, things like that were
　never built, as you well know.」

stage0018_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Evangelion isn't a replacement for those.
　I think ours was the only world that ever needed EVA.」

stage0018_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...Is this my father's work too?」

stage0018_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Sortie...!?
　Unit-00's frozen right now, isn't it, $$リツコ$$!?
　Don't tell me you plan to use Unit-01!?」

stage0018_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$リツコ$$
「You're the one who's going to pilot that.」

stage0018_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...Father... why did you call me here?」

stage0018_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「It's exactly as you're thinking.」

stage0018_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So you're telling me to pilot this and fight?」

stage0018_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't want that!
　Why now, of all times!?
　Didn't you say you didn't need me, Dad!?」

stage0018_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I called you simply because you're needed.」

stage0018_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Because no one else can do it.」

stage0018_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$シンジ$$
「That's impossible...
　I can't do something I've never even heard of!」

stage0018_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$シンジ$$
「No way...
　There's no way I can do this...
　No way I can pilot something like this!」

stage0018_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「If you're getting in, hurry up.
　If not, go home!」

stage0018_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「That thing... it's closing in.」

stage0018_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$リツコ$$
「$$シンジ$$, we're out of time.」

stage0018_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...I don't want to...!
　Not after I came all this way... this isn't fair!」

stage0018_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$, why did you come here?」

stage0018_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「No, you can't run away.
　Not from your father, or worst, from yourself!」

stage0018_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I know that...!
　But there's no way I can do it!」

stage0018_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$レイ#333$$, why are you here!?」

stage0018_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「The backup's no longer usable.
　Once more, $$レイ#333$$.」

stage0018_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$リツコ$$
「Switch Unit-01's core unit
　to L00 type and restart!」

stage0018_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I really am... someone nobody needs...）

stage0018_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$シンジ$$
（This kid... hurt like this, but why...）

stage0018_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$シンジ$$
（...Don't run, don't run,
　don't run, don't run, don't run...!）

stage0018_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll do it...!
　I'll get in and pilot it!」

stage0018_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$大塚$$
「...So, you still won't tell me anything?」

stage0018_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Just as reported, the Angel appeared.
　And we showed you our trump card, Evangelion.
　Beyond that, I'm afraid I can't say more...」

stage0018_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$大塚$$
「Very well.
　Having seen that Angel, if I'm told
　the world will end, I can't refuse to help.」

stage0018_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Thank you, Director $$大塚$$.
　Then I'd like to ask you for one more favor.」

stage0018_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I'll entrust that $$エヴァンゲリオン初号機$$
　and its pilot, $$碇シンジ$$, to the Far East Branch.」

stage0018_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$大塚$$
「...Isn't that one of NERV's
　most critical secrets?」

stage0018_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「You're certainly right about that,
　but a weapon that can't operate is meaningless.」

stage0018_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Including the pilot's training,
　please run combat tests under the Far East Branch.」

stage0018_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$大塚$$
「...Understood.
　When it comes to operating that sort of
　special force, we're no strangers to it either.」

stage0018_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「As for how to operate and maintain Unit-01,
　I'll have someone explain the details later.」

stage0018_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$大塚$$
「I have one question.
　That pilot, $$碇シンジ$$...」

stage0018_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「As you guessed, he's my son」

stage0018_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Excuse me.
　I've brought $$シンジ$$」

stage0018_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Lt. Col. Katsuragi...
　You and Unit-01 are being sent to the Far East Branch」

stage0018_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「You'll depart the moment preparations are ready.
　Also, from now on, in situations outside my orders,
　operational authority goes to Director $$大塚$$」

stage0018_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$大塚$$
（What is with this father and son...）

stage0018_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$城田$$
「...That's the gist of it,
　regarding NERV, who operated
　that Evangelion」

stage0018_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$葵$$
「The gist...?
　That's mostly just things we still don't know」

stage0018_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「This much secrecy...
　That's blatantly suspicious」

stage0018_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But if that monster called an Angel
　is going to cause a Third Impact
　that destroys the world, we can't ignore it」

stage0018_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$n
「$$第３新東京市$$'s underground city, the Geofront...
　So something in the NERV based there could
　trigger a Third Impact...?」

stage0018_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$くらら$$
「Even so, you haven't heard
　what's there either, have you, $$城田$$?」

stage0018_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$城田$$
「Unfortunately, no.
　...But hearing of today's Angel and the
　$$セカンドインパクト$$'s toll, it's surely true」

stage0018_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$タケル$$
「So the Far East Branch's forces
　being deployed around $$第３新東京市$$
　was to counter that Angel...」

stage0018_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「But even from today's battle,
　regular deployed forces would have
　a hard time facing an Angel」

stage0018_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$甲児$$
「We only barely managed it, going all out」

stage0018_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「But hey, if that Evangelion thing exists,
　won't things be fine?」

stage0018_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's got that A.T. Field thing too,
　and man, it went amazing after it got hit!」

stage0018_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「We've got one like that at school too,
　the type that gets strong after crying」

stage0018_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Sorry.
　Guess I went too far with the joke」

stage0018_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$n
「But like $$ワッ太$$ said,
　if that Evangelion joins our forces,
　we might stand even against an Angel」

stage0018_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$n
「Even if it's something we don't understand」

stage0018_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「From how it moved before going berserk,
　whoever's piloting it is worse than a novice」

stage0018_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$竜馬$$
「And as for that rampage,
　that was like letting loose a monster
　nobody could ever control」

stage0018_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$n
「That happened after the enemy disabled it.
　So if we support it well enough to prevent that,
　it shouldn't go berserk」

stage0018_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That ain't the point.
　I'm saying that Evangelion thing is
　something I fundamentally can't trust」

stage0018_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$n
「Even so, it might be an enemy
　we can't beat without using that power」

stage0018_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$竜馬$$
「...$n...
　Since this is a good chance, I'll say it」

stage0018_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Power beyond your own limits will destroy you」

stage0018_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$n
「Are you talking about the $$ジェニオン$$?」

stage0018_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I ain't just saying this to you.
　It's a warning to myself too」

stage0018_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Both of you, stop.
　Now isn't the time for this talk」

stage0018_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$城田$$
「$n has a point too.
　If that Evangelion can just be controlled,
　it's true it'll become a fighting asset」

stage0018_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$城田$$
「Director $$大塚$$ just got in touch,
　and the Far East Branch will take in the unit and pilot」

stage0018_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$大塚$$
「Ah, everyone... good work out there today」

stage0018_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$タケル$$
「Director $$大塚$$, will the Evangelion
　be fighting alongside us?」

stage0018_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Was the pilot okay!?
　They took some crazy hits」

stage0018_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$甲児$$
「From the voice, they sounded like a kid,
　so about how old are they?」

stage0018_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$大塚$$
「Alright, alright.
　I'll answer in order, so wait a bit」

stage0018_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$大塚$$
「But before that, I have a favor to ask you all」

stage0018_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$大塚$$
「That's right.
　It's about $$碇シンジ$$, the pilot of
　EVA Unit-01, who'll be fighting alongside you」

stage0018_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$大塚$$
「I want you to get along with him」

stage0018_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...In the end, all those tests took the whole day」

stage0018_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ミサト$$
「With everything that's happened, are you confused?」

stage0018_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「No...
　I'm just a little tired」

stage0018_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I bet.
　...But I think it's only going to get harder」

stage0018_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Because the Crusher Team at the Far East
　Branch, where we're headed, fights threats to humanity」

stage0018_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...I... I'll keep piloting that EVA from now on...」

stage0018_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You don't have to think about that now.
　...More importantly, look...」

stage0018_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ミサト$$
「This scenery you're looking at right now...
　This is $$第３新東京市$$, the fortress city that fights Angels」

stage0018_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ミサト$$
「And this is the city you protected...」

stage0018_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$ミサト$$
「You did something people would praise,
　something admirable. Be proud of it」

stage0018_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You did it, Master $$甲児$$.
　Wiping out that entire Mechabeast Army」

stage0018_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$甲児$$
「Though the important one, $$あしゅら$$, got away」

stage0018_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That $$あしゅら男爵$$, man and woman both,
　acted all high and mighty, but deep down
　I bet they were plenty nervous」

stage0018_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And on top of that, their anger at Master $$甲児$$
　for wiping out the Mechabeast Army powered up
　even more, producing some truly splendid Z-Chips」

stage0018_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And the amount... a whopping 200 Z!
　I'll add this to the squad's stock」

stage0018_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$甲児$$
「Huh... guess that anger and grudge have their uses」

stage0018_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That one seems set to become a fine customer.
　I look forward to more from them」

stage0018_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What's wrong, Miss $$スズネ$$?
　You look like something's weighing on you...」

stage0018_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$ＡＧ$$...
　Is it really okay for me
　to keep piloting the $$ジェニオン$$...?」

stage0018_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Is this about Master Ruu-Ruu's
　counseling session that's on your mind?」

stage0018_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's not all.
　There's also today's clash with $$竜馬$$...」

stage0018_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I... I keep thinking I'm not being
　much use as $n's partner...」

stage0018_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Did $n say that you, Miss $$スズネ$$,
　are useless?」

stage0018_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Whether you're fit to be $n's partner
　is for $n to decide.
　There's no use in you worrying, Miss $$スズネ$$」

stage0018_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But I'm sure... even if I asked, $n
　would just spare my feelings and not tell me the truth」

stage0018_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Being able to answer that way
　means you understand $n
　pretty well, doesn't it, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

stage0018_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right.
　Well, someone other than you, Miss $$スズネ$$,
　couldn't handle that uptight silent type」

stage0018_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I... I think I'll keep trying a bit longer」

stage0018_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's the spirit.
　No matter what they say, I'm rooting for you, Miss」

stage0018_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'll do my best to live up to your expectations, $$ＡＧ$$」

stage0018_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, not to be outdone,
　I'll get fired up today too... business, business!」
